title: ICE says officer shot New York man because they believe their lives were in danger

blocks.text: N.Y. mayor calls ICE 'rotten to its core' after agents shoot man

Outrage is growing in New York City after federal immigration enforcement agents shot a Dominican man in his car where a five-year-old child was also present. 'What happened today was an outrage,' said Mayor Zohran Mamdani, who also called for ICE to be abolished. The Department of Homeland Security described the man as a 'criminal illegal alien' with a prior grand larceny conviction and a history of other arrests, a claim the man's lawyer denies.

items: A U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agent shot and wounded a 28-year-old Dominican man who was in a car with a five-year-old child Thursday.
The shooting drew outrage from New Yorkers, including Mayor Zohran Mamdani, who called for the release of the wounded man and the end of all ICE enforcement in the city.

In a news conference this morning, U.S. Secretary of Homeland Security Markwayne Mullin said Mamdani’s comments were political theatre and an incitement to violence. A senior ICE official said agents opened fire because they believed their lives were in danger.
Mullin said ICE agents weren’t aware there was a child in the car.
ICE agents have fired their guns during more than a dozen vehicle stops since last year, killing at least four people.
